purpose: Preserve the required Forensic/Quant reporting semantics for all future bots and downstream layers.

daily_audit_report.prediction_count_definition: Number of pairs actually admitted by the prediction gate for that date.
daily_audit_report.hit_count_definition: Number of admitted predicted pairs whose exact pair appears in the authoritative result for that date.
daily_audit_report.hit_pairs_definition: Exact two-digit pairs that hit, preserving leading zeros.
daily_audit_report.total_stake_definition: Sum of recorded stakes for admitted predictions only.
daily_audit_report.total_loss_definition: Sum of losing stakes, explicitly separated from gross stake and payout.
daily_audit_report.total_payout_definition: Gross recorded payout attributable to winning admitted predictions.
daily_audit_report.zero_stake_rule: ROI = NOT_APPLICABLE; never divide by zero.
daily_audit_report.audit_truth: Never infer a hit, stake, loss, payout, or ROI from missing records.

source_policy.advertising_content: NON_DATA; MUST NOT ENTER SOURCE_TRUTH DATASET
source_policy.source_navigation_noise: MUST BE SEPARATED FROM RESULT CONTENT

successor_rule: This contract is persistent project memory. Future bots MUST read and obey it before changing reporting, edge, EV, menu, or audit behavior.
